ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic sentence اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am from Kenya.
   B. I am a pupil (girl).
   C. My name is Ahmad.
   D. I am a pupil (boy).

2. What does the small word min mean in anaa min Kiiniya? (1 mark)
   A. with
   B. for
   C. in
   D. from

3. Which Arabic sentence means "My mother cooks." (1 mark)
   A. عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ
   B. هَذِهِ أُمِّي
   C. هَذَا أَبِي
   D. أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ

4. Which word means 'above'? (1 mark)
   A. taHta
   B. fii
   C. fawqa
   D. ʿalaa

5. Which Arabic sentence means "This is my house." (1 mark)
   A. هَذَا بَيْتِي
   B. الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ
   C. الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ
   D. الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ

6. How is the Arabic word اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ijlis
   B. ismaʿ
   C. uktub
   D. ilmis anfaka

7. Which Arabic sentence means "I go to school on Monday." (1 mark)
   A. الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ
   B. أَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ
   C. فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ
   D. أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ

8. How do you say 'on Monday'? (1 mark)
   A. ghadan l-ithnayn
   B. usbuuʿ l-ithnayn
   C. yawma l-ithnayn
   D. al-yawm ithnayn

9. How is the Arabic word كَعْكَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. kaʿka
   B. taʿaam
   C. ʿasiir
   D. dawruka

10. Which is a good way of reducing food waste? (1 mark)
   A. Throw away leftovers
   B. Take only what you can eat
   C. Cook more than needed
   D. Leave food outside uncovered

11. What does the word wa mean in khubzan wa bayDan? (1 mark)
   A. and
   B. with
   C. or
   D. in

12. What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink water.
   B. I like juice.
   C. I like bananas.
   D. I eat bread.

13. Which Arabic sentence means "I see with my eye." (1 mark)
   A. أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي
   B. أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي
   C. أَتَكَلَّمُ بِفَمِي
   D. أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي

14. What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا رَأْسِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my head.
   B. I smell with my nose.
   C. I hear with my ear.
   D. I see with my eye.

15. Which body part is used for the action 'aktubu' (I write)? (1 mark)
   A. yad, the hand
   B. fam, the mouth
   C. udhun, the ear
   D. anf, the nose

16. What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is hot.
   B. The weather is cloudy.
   C. The weather is rainy.
   D. The weather is cold.

17. What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is cloudy.
   B. The weather is hot.
   C. The weather is rainy.
   D. The weather is cold.

18. What does the Arabic sentence نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is cold.
   B. The weather is rainy.
   C. We look after the environment.
   D. The weather is hot.

19. What does the Arabic sentence شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am in Grade 4.
   B. In my house there is a kitchen.
   C. Water is useful (good for you).
   D. Thank you for listening.

20. How do you read the syllable بَ? (1 mark)
   A. bii
   B. sa
   C. bu
   D. ba

21. How is the syllable بُ read? (1 mark)
   A. ba
   B. bu
   C. bi
   D. baa

22. How many syllables are in the word kataba (ka-ta-ba)? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 1
   C. 4
   D. 2

23. How do you read the syllable سُ? (1 mark)
   A. laa
   B. su
   C. bu
   D. na

24. How is the Arabic word قَلَمٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. kuub
   B. qalam
   C. taawila
   D. sahn

25. Which Arabic word means "festival"? (1 mark)
   A. عِيدٌ
   B. حَلْوَى
   C. لَا
   D. رَقْصٌ

26. What does lii ʿaynaani mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two eyes.
   B. You have two ears.
   C. My eye is big.
   D. I see with my eye.

27. What does the Arabic sentence جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my body.
   B. I have two eyes.
   C. I have two hands.
   D. My body is strong.

28. What is rhyme? (1 mark)
   A. A number
   B. A long word
   C. Words or lines that end with the same sound
   D. A kind of picture

29. What does maa ajmala l-bii'a mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rain is heavy.
   B. Where is the environment?
   C. I plant a tree.
   D. How beautiful the environment is!

30. Which of these is a position word? (1 mark)
   A. ʿinda
   B. kitaab
   C. sariir
   D. qalam

31. Why should a knife be kept out of the reach of small children? (1 mark)
   A. It can cause harm
   B. It is old
   C. It is expensive
   D. It is heavy

32. What is the name of the Arabic letter م? (1 mark)
   A. jiim
   B. baa
   C. alif
   D. miim

33. What is the ending of the letter ة in جَدَّةٌ called? (1 mark)
   A. shadda
   B. sukuun
   C. hamza
   D. taa marbuta

34. Where should you write the Arabic name of a drawing? (1 mark)
   A. Only on the back
   B. Inside the drawing
   C. In the margin from left to right
   D. Under the drawing, from right to left

35. What does at-taawilatu Sagiira mean? (1 mark)
   A. The chair is new.
   B. The door is clean.
   C. The table is small.
   D. The table is big.

36. Which Arabic word means "tomorrow"? (1 mark)
   A. مَدْرَسَةٌ
   B. غَدًا
   C. الْيَوْمَ
   D. الْخَمِيسُ

37. Which Arabic word means "congratulations"? (1 mark)
   A. مَبْرُوكٌ
   B. حَلْوَى
   C. رَقْصٌ
   D. عِيدٌ

38. Which of these is unique about Arabic writing? (1 mark)
   A. It has 26 letters
   B. It has no dots
   C. It has capital letters
   D. It is written from right to left

39. Which Arabic word means "sunny"? (1 mark)
   A. غَائِمٌ
   B. شَمْسٌ
   C. حَارٌّ
   D. مُشْمِسٌ

40. What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is rain.
   B. The wind is strong.
   C. The sun is hot.
   D. This is the sun.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Give two ways of taking care of your body. (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: ayna l-kitaab? (2 marks)

43. Explain why writing the dots correctly is important. Give one example of two letters that differ only by dots. (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: haadhaa matar (2 marks)

45. Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'I eat bread and I drink milk.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Arrange these sentences into a good paragraph and give a reason: uhibbu baytii / haadhaa baytii / baytii kabiir. (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Write three classroom instructions in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: marhaban yaa Ahmad (2 marks)

49. Say what a vocabulary bank is and how you can make one from a poem. (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into English: azraʿu shajara (2 marks)

51. Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla (2 marks)

52. Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u ya'kuluuna l-kaʿka (2 marks)

53. Translate into English: al-kursiyyu jadiid (2 marks)

54. Translate into English: haadhaa jismii (2 marks)

55. Write three Arabic questions about a picture of a party and give their meanings. (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Write one Arabic sentence about a household item using a describing word, and translate it. (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into English: anaa uhibbu l-hafla (2 marks)

58. Translate into English: kulla ʿaamin wa-antum bi-khayr (2 marks)

59. Translate into English: al-jawwu haarr (2 marks)

60. Put these letters in order to make a day: ت ب س. Write the word and its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

61. Spell the word باب by naming the letters in order, and give its meaning. (3 marks) (3 marks)

62. Translate into English: al-mawzu ladhiidh (2 marks)

63. Translate: al-qittatu taHta s-sariir. al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila. (2 marks) (2 marks)

64. Translate into English: fii l-ghurfati sariir (2 marks)

65. Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii. (2 marks) (2 marks)

66. Name three Arabic writing styles and state one use of one of them. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — My name is Ahmad.
   اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ (ismii Ahmad) means: My name is Ahmad.

2. D — from
   min means 'from', so the sentence says 'I am from Kenya'.

3. D — أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ
   أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ (ummii tatbukhu) means: My mother cooks.

4. C — fawqa
   fawqa means above. taHta means under, fii means in and ʿalaa means on.

5. A — هَذَا بَيْتِي
   هَذَا بَيْتِي (haadhaa baytii) means: This is my house.

6. D — ilmis anfaka
   اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ is read ilmis anfaka and means touch your nose.

7. D — أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ
   أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ (adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn) means: I go to school on Monday.

8. C — yawma l-ithnayn
   yawma l-ithnayn means 'on the day of Monday'.

9. A — kaʿka
   كَعْكَةٌ is read kaʿka and means cake.

10. B — Take only what you can eat
   Taking only what you can eat and saving leftovers reduces waste.

11. A — and
   wa means 'and', so the phrase is 'bread and eggs'.

12. C — I like bananas.
   أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ (uhibbu l-mawza) means: I like bananas.

13. D — أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي
   أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي (anaa araa biʿaynii) means: I see with my eye.

14. A — This is my head.
   هَذَا رَأْسِي (haadhaa raʾsii) means: This is my head.

15. A — yad, the hand
   We write with the hand (yad).

16. B — The weather is cloudy.
   الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ (al-jawwu ghaa'im) means: The weather is cloudy.

17. D — The weather is cold.
   الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ (al-jawwu baarid) means: The weather is cold.

18. C — We look after the environment.
   نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ (nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a) means: We look after the environment.

19. D — Thank you for listening.
   شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ (shukran li-istimaaʿikum) means: Thank you for listening.

20. D — ba
   بَ is read ba.

21. B — bu
   The mark Damma gives the vowel u, so بُ is bu.

22. A — 3
   ka + ta + ba makes three syllables.

23. B — su
   سُ is read su.

24. B — qalam
   قَلَمٌ is read qalam and means pen.

25. A — عِيدٌ
   عِيدٌ (ʿiid) means festival.

26. A — I have two eyes.
   lii means I have and ʿaynaani means two eyes.

27. D — My body is strong.
   جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ (jismii qawiyy) means: My body is strong.

28. C — Words or lines that end with the same sound
   Rhyme is when words or lines end with the same sound.

29. D — How beautiful the environment is!
   maa ajmala is a cry of wonder meaning 'how beautiful'.

30. A — ʿinda
   ʿinda means at. The other words are things.

31. A — It can cause harm
   Sharp items can hurt small children.

32. D — miim
   The letter م is called miim.

33. D — taa marbuta
   ة is taa marbuta and appears at the end of many feminine words.

34. D — Under the drawing, from right to left
   Labels are written neatly from right to left.

35. C — The table is small.
   taawila is table and Sagiira means small.

36. B — غَدًا
   غَدًا (ghadan) means tomorrow.

37. A — مَبْرُوكٌ
   مَبْرُوكٌ (mabruuk) means congratulations.

38. D — It is written from right to left
   Arabic runs from right to left and has 28 letters and no capitals.

39. D — مُشْمِسٌ
   مُشْمِسٌ (mushmis) means sunny.

40. D — This is the sun.
   هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ (haadhihi shams) means: This is the sun.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands and face; clean teeth; eat good food; sleep well.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible way.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Where is the book?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: A wrong dot changes the letter and the word. For example ف has one dot above and ق has two dots above.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for changes the letter, 1 mark for changes the word, 1 mark for a correct example.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is rain.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: aakulu l-khubza wa ashrabu l-haliiba. I eat bread and I drink milk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: haadhaa baytii. baytii kabiir. uhibbu baytii. The topic comes first, then a detail, then the feeling at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first sentence, 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the reason.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example qif (stand up), ijlis (sit down), iftahi l-baab (open the door).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct instruction with meaning.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Hello, Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: A vocabulary bank keeps new words for later. Pick out the words from the poem and write each with its sound, meaning and a picture on cards.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 2 marks for the method.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: I plant a tree.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends are at the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends eat the cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: The chair is new.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my body.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example ayna l-kaʿka? (Where is the cake?) man haadhaa? (Who is this?) maadhaa fawqa t-taawila? (What is above the table?)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct question with meaning.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example al-baabu kabiir. The door is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct sentence, 1 mark for a matching describing word and 1 mark for the translation.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: May you be well every year.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is hot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: سبت (sabt), Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: baa, alif, baa. It means door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the letters, 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the meaning.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: The banana is delicious.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

63. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cat is under the bed. The lamp is above the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

64. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the room there is a bed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

65. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

66. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example Naskh, Ruqʿah and Kufic. Naskh is used in printed books.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each style named (up to 2) and 1 mark for a correct use.
